about.text: When unripe, Kalimpong cheese is a little like the Welsh Caerphilly, slightly acidic and a little crumbly with a relatively smooth (edible) rind and not particularly strong-smelling.

sources.text: Unpasteurised cow's milk, 1 kg and 12 kg wheels, Gouda-like; eaten young and white, slightly crumbly, or kept a few months in the fridge when it moulds more
